Technology stocks were mixed in Tuesday trading, with shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 up 0.3% while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was falling almost 0.3%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) eBay ( EBAY ) traded as much as 6% higher on Tuesday amid unconfirmed market speculation activist investor Carl Icahn is taking a stake in the online auctions and sales company.
In other sector news:
(+) Tower Semiconductor ( TSEM ) climbed over 6% at one point on Tuesday after Jefferies began coverage of the Israeli chipmaker specializing in analog and mixed-signal semiconductor devices with a buy recommendation.
(-) Blackbaud ( BLKB ) tumbled 15% after the cloud software company cut its adjuted FY18 earning and revenue outlooks. Blackbaud is expecting non-GAAP net income in a range of $2.46 to $2.52 per share, down from its prior forecast expecting $2.75 to $2.88 per share and lagging the consensus estimate of analysts.
